title: Evidence bundle manifest
description: bundle-manifest.json in an evidence/v1 export: the runner-signed list of every other file in the export with its digest and size. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; the signature verifies over the canonical form without the signature; entries have unique paths (compared case-insensitively; an exporter writes them sorted by path and a verifier does not check the order); each entry digest and size match the file; first_sequence is at most last_sequence; 1 to 64 entries; the file is at most 1 MiB. The manifest never lists itself. signature and signing_key_id are optional in the shipped Go struct but the decoder rejects a manifest without them, so the schema requires them.

view.description: Name of the export view; absent for the full export.

spec_version.description: Strict x.y.z version of the evidence export spec.

canon_version.description: The checkpoint-family canonical-form version; 1 in evidence/v1.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

sequence.description: A chain sequence number, at most 2^53-1.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC in Go's form: Z suffix, no offset, an optional fraction of 1 to 9 digits whose last digit is not 0. Year 0000 and impossible calendar days are not excluded by the pattern.

signature.description: An Ed25519 signature: 64 raw bytes as standard padded base64, 88 characters ending ==.

ref.description: A reference of at most 1024 bytes with no .. path segment; the length bound and the segment rule are not expressible here.

path.description: A file of an export other than the manifest itself, relative to the export directory.

size.description: File size in bytes; at most 256 MiB for records.ndjson and tool-events.ndjson and 1 MiB for every other file.

inclusionProof.description: A Merkle inclusion proof (RFC 6962). leaf_index is below tree_size and audit_path has exactly the length the two numbers imply (at most 64 entries); the schema cannot express either.
